versions.content: Behavior of DTC query functions for suppressed DTCs In case any of the following APIs is called • Dem_GetStatusOfDTC • Dem_GetSeverityOfDTC • Dem_GetFunctionalUnitOfDTC • Dem_ClearDTC on a single selected DTC which is suppressed, the Dem shall return DEM_WRONG_DTC.
